items.title: Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Undervalued After Its New Cybersecurity Partnership?
items.summary: Nozomi Networks has teamed up with Lockheed Martin (LMT) to build automated cybersecurity and configuration compliance tools for defense networks, tied to the F-35 offset program for Switzerland. Lockheed Martin’s share price has cooled recently, with the stock down 3.37% over the past week and 6.40% over the past month. This comes even as fresh F-35 related awards, record third quarter backlog and new cyber partnerships keep the longer term story in focus. Scan beyond Lockheed Martin and see...
